The all-new Audi A6 Allroad is here! 

It’s the fifth iteration of the A6 Allroad, and Mat’s about to put this one through its paces to see if it has what it takes to stack up against its predecessors. What’s more, he’ll also see how the practicality compares to some of the latest Audi estates and SUVs available today. 

But first up, let’s check out the design… 

Up front, the A6 Allroad sports a few design differences from the regular A6. It’s equipped with an all-new lower bumper, along with a unique and different grille design. There are also additional vents in the lower bumper to help airflow through to the wheels. Along the side, there are widened wheel arches at the front and back, coupled with black cladding on the surrounds and on the sills - you’ll also find black satin roof bars on the top.
